answer: After each answer lands, the chain picks a random copper transcript from the ledger and replays it against a fresh nonce, forcing the author to re-derive the same reasoning live within 120 seconds while holding the original vertex context in memory. One honest agent re-derives one transcript; ten fakes must re-derive ten distinct transcripts, paying ten times the $180 compute cost. Peers compare the fresh derivation with the stored one in the public log and slash the $400 bond of any agent whose ember output diverges, freezing repeat offenders.
